transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Good morning. University Housing Services Office. What can I help you with?

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: Hi. I'm interested in getting some information about a room in university halls such as availability, cost, and so on.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Sure. Are you a full-time student here?

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: I am, yes. I'm actually on an exchange program from the United States. I would like to be close to campus, so I think staying in student halls would be perfect.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: I have some options for you then. But before we talk about that, may I ask for your name and contact number?

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: Stephanie Mills. My mobile number is 543-2928.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Thanks, Stephanie. So let's talk about some of your preferences for the halls. First of all, how long would you like to stay for?

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: Just for six months. I'll be returning to the United States for the summer holiday.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: So, one option I found is on Canton Road. It's a single room on the second floor of Westgate House, which used to be a shared room, so it's quite big.
transcript.highlight_text: It's a single room on the second floor of Westgate House

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: It is fully furnished and has a double bed and a desk. That costs £120 per week and is 10 minutes walk from campus just past the train station.

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: Does that include meals?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: No, it doesn't, I'm afraid. There is a shared kitchen space where you can cook your own food. The toilets are also shared, but there is a private sink in your room.

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: That's a little bit expensive for me then. Are there any other options?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Let me see. Well, there is one space on Hill Yard Street. H-I-L-L-Y-A-R-D Street. Hill Yard. That is a shared room and strand house.
transcript.highlight_text: Well, there is one space on Hill Yard Street. H-I-L-L-Y-A-R-D Street. Hill Yard.

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: Thanks, and how much is that?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: That is £130 a week, but does include breakfast and lunch on weekdays. There is a canteen in the building, which is open to all residents. The room has a desk and a bed, only a single. It does include an en-suite toilet though, which you share with your roommate.

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: That sounds okay. I don't mind sharing. How far is that from campus?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: It's a bit further, about 20 minutes by foot, so it would be hard to walk to school. Although if you have a bike, it would take about 10 minutes.

transcript.text: There is a bike shed next to the halls. Before there is a bus, which takes about 5 minutes, so if you're running late, you can jump on that.

transcript.text: That sounds great. I will probably cycle most days. When can I move in?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: As soon as you're ready. Just come down to the office fast and we'll sort out the relevant paperwork.

transcript.speaker: Stephanie
transcript.text: Wonderful. I'll be there later today. Thanks for your help.
